title: FFRDC spun off from TRW as principal contractor for about 29 years

tellings.quote: only one and I won't name it um started out as a contractor in 1960s 30 not too long after it was born was actually spin-off of TRW

plain: A single government-funded research center, run outside the government on its behalf, is said to have been the main contractor on work tied to recovered unknown technology for about 29 years, starting in the 1960s. The physicist Eric W. Davis passes this on from what he was told. He says the outfit started as a contractor not long after it was born, that it was a spin-off of TRW, an American defense and aerospace company, and that he will not name it. If true, one quiet organization would have held this work for nearly three decades.
